questions: How many islands and step edges did you measure with STS, and how many showed the edge peak near EF? The 20 islands on p. 4 refer to the band gap, and Fig. S11 is not in this version.
Were any islands or edges set aside, and why?
Which bias ranges, map energies, set-points and island sizes did you measure beyond the -0.1 to +0.1 V spectra and the single +7 mV map in Fig. 5?
What does the second-best island or edge look like, in point spectra and in a map?

Does the edge enhancement extend across the whole gap up to the conduction band edge near 290 meV? In your Fig. 5(b) the peak sits within about 10 meV of the valence band edge you place at about -10 meV, and the edge curve falls below the center curve above about +20 mV.
How does the "V-shaped dip between ±50 mV" in the center spectrum of Fig. 5(b) relate to the gap from about -10 to 290 meV in the Fig. 4(a) inset, and how large were the islands used for each?
Did you measure step edges of the semiconducting ML-Si2Te2 on Sb2Te3 from your Refs. 29 and 30 with similar tips and set-points, and do they show a similar peak?
Was the Fig. 5(e) map taken with the feedback set at Vstab = 0.2 V at each pixel, and does the ring persist in a constant-height map or at a set-point outside the gap?
